henry.title: Moon Words: Describing Words + a MOON Poem
henry.intro: Find strong describing words, then write a MOON acrostic poem. (Redo of last week's unfinished lesson. About 15 minutes.)
steps: 🔍 Read the chunks. Spot the describing words.
🌕 Pick 4 describing words from the word bank.
✍️ Write a MOON poem: one line per letter.
links: NASA Space Place: All About the Moon
Read the Quick Facts box. Find a describing word for the Moon.

passage.text: 🌕 A describing word is called an adjective. It tells how something looks, feels or sounds. Example: the bright Moon.
passage.q: In 'the bright Moon', which word describes?

passage.text: 👀 Use your senses. The Moon is gray, dusty and silent. There is no air, so there is no sound.
passage.q: Name one describing word for the Moon.

passage.text: 📝 In an acrostic poem, the first letters spell a word down the side. M: Moon dust on my boots. O: Only quiet all around. O: Orbiting Earth. N: Night lamp in the sky.
passage.q: What word do the first letters spell?

worksheet: Circle the describing words: The dusty Moon (dusty / Moon) · A bright star (bright / star)
Space Place says the Moon is a ______, cratered place. Circle: rocky / wet
The Moon is silent because there is no ______. Circle: air / light
Check: ☐ 4 lines ☐ 2 or more describing words ☐ capital letters
henry.challenge: Write a STAR acrostic too. Or finish a simile: 'The Moon is as ______ as ______.'

frankie.title: Build a Rocket! 🚀
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud: Rockets carry astronauts up, up, up to space. Today we build a rocket from paper shapes, then read rocket words! (Redo of last week's unfinished lesson. About 14 minutes.)

handsOn.title: 🚀 Shape rocket
steps: ✂️ Grown-up cuts: 1 big triangle, 1 rectangle, 2 circles, 2 small triangles.
🧩 Frankie glues the rectangle first, then the big triangle on top.
🪟 Glue 2 circle windows and 2 fins at the bottom.
🔢 Count: how many triangles? How many circles? Then count down 10 to 1: blast off!
handsOn.look: Grown-up: name each shape as he glues it. 'Triangle on the TOP.'
handsOn.q: Count the shapes on your sheet.

worksheet:
